title: VFD motor wiring
goal: A reader must be able to follow three-phase power through protection and a line reactor into a drive, then identify its motor, braking, and control connections.

rubric.must: Three supply phases L1, L2, and L3 are visibly shown through a 16 A three-pole breaker.
Three clearly labelled LR1 line-reactor legs are visible between the breaker and drive.
A variable frequency drive labelled 400 VAC and 4 kW is visible.
A 400 VAC 4 kW three-phase motor is visibly connected to U, V, and W drive outputs.
A braking resistor with a 100 ohm 300 W rating is visible at the drive braking terminals.
RUN, FORWARD REVERSE, speed potentiometer, and VFD fault relay control items are visible.

ideal.notes: Reviewed. Split into power, braking and control. The drive's terminals carry the names real drives use — R/L1 S/L2 T/L3 in, U/T1 V/T2 W/T3 out, P+/PB braking, DI/AI control, RA/AC fault contact — with the line reactor in the supply and the speed pot's wiper on the analogue input.
